paragraphs: The project aimed to develop a plant watering reminder system using an STM32F103C8T6 microcontroller and a soil moisture sensor. The system was designed to monitor the soil moisture level, trigger an audible alert when the soil is dry, and turn on an LED to indicate the water status. The system operates in real-time, with deterministic logic evaluation and autonomous actuation without cloud dependency. However, the project faced limitations due to the limited processing power of the microcontroller and the need for additional hardware components such as a soil moisture sensor module and an active buzzer alert module.
